title: Leftover Hash Bound
statement: Let $S$, $\alpha$, and $\beta$ be finite sets, with $S$ and $\beta$ nonempty. Suppose $f\colon S\to\alpha\to\beta$ is universal, and let $X$ be a probability distribution on $\alpha$ such that $X(x)\le 2^{-k}$ for every $x\in\alpha$, for some real number $k$. The statistical distance between the distribution of $(s,f(s,x))$, for independent uniform $s\in S$ and $x$ distributed according to $X$, and the uniform distribution on $S\times\beta$ is at most $\frac12\sqrt{|\beta|2^{-k}}$.
hypotheses_covered: $X$ is a probability distribution on $\alpha$ with $X(x)\le 2^{-k}$ for all $x$
